summary: Full re-test after iteration_1 blocker fix. All previously-blocked RBAC / adjustment / extension / refund / cancel / voucher / audit paths verified end-to-end. Backend 14/14 pytest passes; Frontend menu RBAC filtering by role verified for cashier/accountant/admin; End-to-end receipt issuance via UI (Students -> student detail -> New Receipt with preselected student -> Issue Receipt -> /receipts/{id} print view) works and produces EP-2026-000007 with correct print layout.

minor.issue: Cookie is set with samesite=none + secure=true. Works fine behind HTTPS ingress; in some private LAN HTTP deployments this cookie will be silently dropped. Bearer-token fallback works so functionally OK, but worth documenting.

Rejects installments if abs(sum - outstanding) > 0.01. This is correct behaviour; but the 400 error text embeds ₹ in the string which some non-utf8 clients may mangle. Consider adding structured detail field.

Cashier POST /api/adjustments -> 200 status=pending. Cashier approve -> 403. Manager approve -> 200 -> status becomes approved (verified via GET)
POST /api/extensions with valid installments (3 entries: overdue/today/tomorrow) by cashier -> 200. Cashier approve -> 403. Manager approve -> 200 and materialises 3 rows in db.reminders
GET /api/reminders?status=pending returns enriched entries with student + bucket in {overdue,today,tomorrow,future}
POST /api/receipts/{id}/cancel by cashier -> 403; by manager with reason -> 200; receipt status=cancelled
POST /api/receipts/{id}/reprint allowed for any authenticated user; reprint_count increments (verified 2 increments)
GET /api/reports/collection with NO date params -> 200 (defaults to today)
Frontend sidebar RBAC: Cashier sees NO Fee Structure / Administration; Accountant sees Fee Structure but NOT Administration; Admin sees both

Frontend E2E: Admin login -> Students -> click first student -> click sd-new-receipt button (URL becomes /new-receipt?student=<id>) -> student is preselected on New Receipt page -> select School Fee -> pick Tuition Fee -> amount 1000 -> click Issue Receipt -> redirects to /receipts/{id} print layout showing 'BALAJI CONVENT & JUNIOR COLLEGE', Receipt No EP-2026-000007, amount-in-words 'One Thousand Rupees Only', cashier name, payer signature blocks
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 750+ lines with all routers, models, seed logic and utils in a single file. Recommend splitting into routers/, models/, services/, seed.py to improve maintainability - this is a soft/quality concern, not a bug.
seed_data() runs unconditionally on startup. Fine while dataset is small (<1s) but should short-circuit when all seeds already present to avoid repeated find_one queries on each boot.
Refund receipts share the same {DEPT}-{YEAR}-NNNNNN counter as school receipts. Business teams often want a separate refund/CN series - flagging as an open product question.
amount_in_words_inr() ignores paise (rounds to int). Acceptable for INR bank receipts but should be documented.

list_reminders() returns due_date bucket computed via string compare on ISO dates - correct only if due_date is stored as ISO string; ensured by insertion path but a str type assertion or a Pydantic model would harden this.
